name: Wilgendaal
description: A Flemish city's website, in Dutch, built for accessibility and designed with soft corners, framed panels and photographs with a tab cut into them: the town and what you want to arrange first, six life events, 46 services under 10 themes, an A to Z, online forms, news, events, participation, the council, locations open right now, notices with tagged PDFs and a Flemish accessibility statement.
